tests.name: followup_candidate_normalizes_arbitrary_payloads
tests.rationale: Worker decision artifacts are external JSON; follow-up normalization should never crash on malformed but JSON-parseable payload fields.
tests.code:
from hypothesis import given, strategies as st
from enoch_control_plane.enoch_core.logic import followup_candidate_from_decision_payload

jsonish = st.recursive(st.none() | st.booleans() | st.integers() | st.floats(allow_nan=False, allow_infinity=False) | st.text(max_size=30), lambda c: st.lists(c, max_size=5) | st.dictionaries(st.text(max_size=20), c, max_size=5), max_leaves=30)

@given(st.dictionaries(st.text(max_size=30), jsonish, max_size=10))
def test_followup_candidate_normalizes_arbitrary_payloads(payload):
    result = followup_candidate_from_decision_payload(payload)
    assert isinstance(result, dict)
    assert isinstance(result['followup_recommended'], bool)
    assert result['followup_type'] in {'', 'deepen', 'branch', 'retry'}
    assert isinstance(result['followup_required_evidence'], list)
    assert all(isinstance(item, str) for item in result['followup_required_evidence'])

tests.name: queue_projection_handles_empty_shapes
tests.rationale: Queue projection should handle absent queue/paper rows deterministically for dashboard read models.
tests.code:
from hypothesis import given, strategies as st
from enoch_control_plane.enoch_core.logic import queue_projection

@given(st.text(max_size=20), st.text(max_size=20))
def test_queue_projection_handles_empty_shapes(source, captured_at):
    result = queue_projection({'source': source, 'captured_at': captured_at})
    assert result['source'] == source.strip()
    assert result['captured_at'] == captured_at
    assert result['total_queue_rows'] == 0
    assert result['total_paper_rows'] == 0
    assert result['warnings'] == []
